howItWorks.title: From Unpaid Bills to Guaranteed Payroll in 5 Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No complex collateral. No branch visits. Just a clear bridge over your cash gaps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Link your Tally, QuickBooks or Bank Statement via Account Aggregator in 60 seconds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI analyzes 12 months of customer payment habits to forecast actual pay dates.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Get notified 18–30 days before a shortfall hits your payroll or vendor checks.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Tap once to unlock an invoice-backed micro-loan directly into your current account.
howItWorks.step5Desc: When your delayed customer settles their bill, the loan clears automatically.

trust.title: Built on Trust, Consent & Indian Banking Norms
trust.pillar1Desc: Every forecast shows the exact 'Why?' — which customer delayed, which GST or wage outflow is due.
trust.pillar2Desc: Loans are disbursed by licensed Small Finance Banks and NBFCs with standardized Key Facts Statements.
trust.pillar3Desc: Read-only access via RBI Account Aggregator framework. Your data is encrypted and never sold.

assistant.title: Khata AI Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask questions about your cashflow, invoices, and loans in Hindi or English.
assistant.placeholder: Ask: 'Kab tak Kapoor Retailers se payment aayegi?'
assistant.q1: Why is Day 18 showing a shortfall?
assistant.q2: When will Kapoor Retailers pay their bill?
assistant.q3: How does auto-repayment work for the bridge loan?
assistant.a1: Day 18 has a ₹2.1L deficit because Kapoor Retailers' ₹1.85L invoice is delayed, while GST (₹1.4L) and artisan wages (₹1.15L) are due simultaneously.
assistant.a2: Kapoor Retailers typically pays 41 days late. While due on 24 Oct, our AI models predict their funds will clear around 20 Nov 2026.
assistant.a3: When Kapoor Retailers transfers ₹1.85L to your HDFC Current Account, our banking integration detects the receipt and auto-settles the loan principal and interest.
